caption: The drawing depicts a brown-toned sculpture of a man and a horse, presented on an oval, tiered wooden base. The man stands upright with his left arm extended upward, holding the horse's bridle in his left hand. He is dressed in a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, trousers, and shoes. The horse is positioned beside the man and faces forward, raising its left front leg, and has a detailed mane and tail. Both figures stand atop an irregular, textured platform that is part of the base, which itself has a softly rounded and polished appearance. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects or scenery visible.
title: Horse and Man Woodcarving
